_doc: Triple Draft settings. Offers: each tier gets tierWeights share of the draws (uniform inside a tier); a player who fits an open slot (overall there >= viability.minOverallAtSlot) is needWeight x likelier; one who fits nothing open (and no bench slot is open) is uselessWeight x as likely. From lateOpenSlots open slots down, all offers must fit an open slot. Themed rounds (setting) every themedEvery rounds: all options from one NFL team, one division, or rookies/young players (age <= rookieMaxAge); a theme needs themeMinPool candidates. Backups (Quick Draft): undrafted players natural at the position with overall <= backupMaxOvr, drawn from the best backupTopN. Spread prediction: simulate spreadSims games. AI drafters: rerollBelow = reroll when the best option is worse than this at its best open slot; stackerBonus = chemistry bonus per real teammate.
